features.title: Autonomous agent action queue ingestion and multi-factor risk scoring engine
acceptance: Ingests agent action proposals via POST /api/actions with automated blast radius, reversibility, and resource criticality scoring
Enforces deterministic policy guardrails with regex pattern matching and auto-reject violation rules
Lists and filters proposals by status, risk tier, and action type with queue summary metrics

features.title: Role-based human-in-the-loop review workflow and parameter modification
acceptance: Requires analyst role for standard reviews and administrator role for critical risk proposals
Supports APPROVE, REJECT, and MODIFY_AND_APPROVE with mandatory decision rationale
Re-scores modified payloads before approval, blocking escalation beyond reviewer authority

features.title: Cryptographic approval receipts and tamper-evident audit hash chain
acceptance: Generates immutable HMAC-SHA256 signed receipts chained to prior receipt hash for every review decision
Provides single receipt verification and full ledger unbroken chain continuity verification
Supports Markdown export of cryptographic receipts with signed manifests

features.title: Automatic action proposal expiration sweep and review refusal
acceptance: Proposals past expires_at automatically transition to expired status during queue operations
Expired proposals log ACTION_EXPIRED to audit log and cannot be claimed or reviewed
UI reflects expired status badge and disables review action forms

features.title: Action audit trail inspection and timeline tracking
acceptance: GET /api/actions/{action_id}/audit-trail returns chronological audit entries with actors, roles, event types, and structured details
ActionDetailModal presents an interactive audit trail activity log showing full chain-of-custody history
Validates role-based access control and handles 404 for missing actions

features.title: Automated dispatch webhook for downstream agent execution upon approval
acceptance: Configurable HTTPS webhook endpoint receiving signed approval payload and receipt token upon approval
Webhook delivery retries with exponential backoff and dispatch audit event logging
